license_note: The Hugging Face weight repository carries no license file of its own and points to the LICENSE file in the MiniMax-M2.1 GitHub repository. That document reproduces the MIT grant but requires any commercial product or service using the software or its derivatives to prominently display 'MiniMax M2.1' — with no user-count or revenue threshold, unlike the M2 terms — so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: MiniMax-M2.1 model weights, repository code, and derivative works, as linked from the Hugging Face model card

access_boundary: This record represents the MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.1 repository release at Hugging Face commit cd97f59135f37b2a6bf09356e485d5e4aeb7dc9c (last modified 2026-02-13). The MiniMax-M2 predecessor, later M2.x releases and the M3 generation, the highspeed endpoint tier, the MiniMax Agent product, the MiniMax Open Platform API, and downstream quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: MiniMax publishes 130 Safetensors shards with in-repository deployment guides for SGLang, vLLM, Transformers, and MLX
The MiniMax Open Platform documentation lists MiniMax-M2.1 as a served model at 204,800 context alongside its highspeed tier
tradeoffs: The governing license lives in a separate GitHub repository rather than alongside the weights, and its threshold-free attribution duty covers any commercial use
Dated December 2025 repository history with no stated retirement posture, and development continues on a mutable main branch
